missing-accessible-name.name: Missing accessible name
missing-accessible-name.graph_modelling_rationale: Needs node + label + ARIA relationship reasoning.

poor-semantic-structure.name: Poor semantic structure
poor-semantic-structure.graph_modelling_rationale: Needs heading, landmark, list, table, and parent-child relationships.

unclear-link-button-purpose.name: Unclear link/button purpose
unclear-link-button-purpose.graph_modelling_rationale: Needs text, accessible name, visual label, and surrounding context.

dynamic-content-not-announced.name: Dynamic content not announced
dynamic-content-not-announced.graph_modelling_rationale: Needs event/state-change graph and ARIA live-region reasoning.

touch-pointer-target-issue.name: Touch/pointer target issue
touch-pointer-target-issue.graph_modelling_rationale: Needs bounding boxes, spatial adjacency, and interaction modelling.

media-alternative-issue.name: Media alternative issue
media-alternative-issue.graph_modelling_rationale: Mostly content/media metadata; less graph-heavy unless media is embedded in complex UI.

authentication-error-prevention-issue.name: Authentication/error-prevention issue
authentication-error-prevention-issue.graph_modelling_rationale: Good for process-level graph across multiple pages/states.
